tasks.title: Turn on Hyper-V on this PC
tasks.instructions:
This turns on Hyper-V, the Windows feature that can run a second computer inside this one, so video work can happen off your screen. It does not restart the PC.

On this PC:

1. Click Start.
2. Type PowerShell.
3. Right-click Windows PowerShell.
4. Click Run as administrator.
5. If a window says Do you want to allow this app to make changes to your device?, click Yes.
6. Click in the blue window, paste the line below, and press Enter.

```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Users\ahogg\Projects\Gracechase\tools\vm\setup-hyperv.ps1"
```

That line runs a setup file already saved on this PC. It turns Hyper-V on. It does not restart the computer.

You should see a line that says Hyper-V is already enabled. or Restart Windows before creating the VM. This script did not restart it.

Then tap Complete.

tasks.title: Turn on SVM in the Gigabyte startup menu
tasks.instructions:

On this PC, while it is starting up:

2. When the Gigabyte logo is on the screen, press Delete.
3. Open Tweaker, then Advanced CPU Settings. If SVM Mode is not there, open Settings, then AMD CBS. This motherboard is a B550 VISION D-P.
4. Set SVM Mode to Enabled.
5. Press F10. Click Yes when it asks you to save.
6. Wait until the Windows desktop is back.
7. Click Start, click your account picture, then click Sign out. Sign back in.

You should be at the Windows desktop, and you should have signed out and back in once.

Then tap Complete.
